verdict.rationale: The evidence documents real-time sync, WebSocket transport and client-side state management for live updates. Nothing shows offline-capable clients, a local write queue, or automatic replay of writes on reconnect. A community comment contrasts Convex's remote query execution with Firestore's local sync, noting Firestore gets better offline behavior, which is consistent with no documented offline-write capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build offline-capable clients whose local writes sync automatically on reconnect
